rules: One ticket = one outcome someone can finish and check. Title is an imperative sentence.
IDs (FB-n) are permanent. New tickets take the next free number (meta.next_id, then increase it). Never reuse or renumber.
Work only on tickets with status todo (or in_progress). A proposed ticket needs Dávid's go first: then set it to todo.
When a ticket is done, delete it and record the outcome where it belongs: a decision in docs/DECISIONS.md, behaviour in docs/SPEC.md. Git history keeps the rest.
Keep this file valid JSON (double quotes, no trailing commas). Check with: node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('docs/backlog.json'))"

fields.title: Imperative, what will be true when done
fields.type: feature | bug | chore | test | content | decision | research
fields.status: proposed (needs Dávid's go) | todo | in_progress | blocked (say why in blocked_by or depends_on) | parked (tried or postponed; do not start unless asked) | rejected (decided against; do not propose again)
fields.priority: P1 = needed for its milestone | P2 = should be done in its milestone | P3 = nice to have
fields.owner: david (accounts, decisions, Studio content) | agent (code, docs) | admin (her content and feedback)
fields.estimate: S = under 1 hour | M = up to half a day | L = more. Agent working time, or the owner's time for non-code tickets
fields.acceptance: List of checks that are each true or false
fields.depends_on: Ticket ids that must be done first
fields.blocked_by: Something outside the backlog that must happen first
fields.due: Optional date (YYYY-MM-DD) the ticket cannot be done before or must be done by, as notes say
fields.refs: Files and doc sections to read first
